title: Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics
content: Thermodynamics and statistical mechanics bridge the microscopic states of individual particles to the macroscopic behavior of bulk systems. From the classical entropy laws and statistical ensembles to the quantum statistical limits of degeneracy pressure, this roadmap traces the flow of energy, phase transitions, and the cosmological arrow of time.
